text: Completed exact-view and minimal field algebra in image4s. Added LatticeMap[D] as the single checked target-to-source integer-affine view model for identity, crop, signed strided permutation, flip, and positive per-axis stride; Sampled.view composes the discrete affine with Grid.indexToFrame and executes only Ravel slice/permute views. Existing spatialView is now a facade; added flipSpatial, permuteSpatial, strideSpatial, coordinate-preserving non-spatial permutation, mapValuesAs, Ravel-owned exact zip kernels, replaceDataChecked, and rectangular non-spatial reduction scaffolding. Non-representable maps are rejected from the zero-copy API and broader transforms are documented as explicit materialization or reframe4s resampling. Added shared JVM/Scala.js laws for identity/composition, crop composition, flip involution, permutation inverse, stride coordinates, exhaustive target/source physical-point equality, value pullback, field-map composition, checked replacement/reduction, axis-coordinate permutation, and negative cases. Added JVM allocation guard over 294912 stored values: crop 29376 B, flip 30048 B, permutation 30352 B, stride 27456 B median allocation, demonstrating metadata/view allocation rather than buffer copies. Complete non-locus court passed: 270 test executions across geometry, core, reference, NIfTI, and laws on JVM and Scala.js. git diff --check passed. The canonical Mote store is in sibling reframe4s, so no image4s path reservation was expressible; work remained scoped to the claimed child and pre-existing user-owned locus edits were untouched.
